expert_reading: A regression test for a cross-viewer bleed bug (the second of several simultaneously-mounted PDF viewers rendering into the first one's DOM, or a singleton await-guard on ViewRegistry cancelling a sibling's fetch mid-flight): it mounts three differently-paged pdf-lib fixtures at once in the stage reader and asserts, scoped strictly per-slide, that each slide's page count, canvas ink, and Next-button navigation belong to its own fixture rather than a neighbor's.

expert_reading: A Playwright end-to-end test of the viewer's pdf module against a pdf-lib-generated two-page (and eight-page) fixture served through an intercepted GitHub-contents API, covering mode selection, rasterization, continuous-scroll pager sync, lazy slide release, and phone-width header geometry.
